input: How do I reset my password?

expected.answer: Open Settings, choose Security and select Reset password. The emailed link expires after 30 minutes.

input: Can I get my money back on an annual plan?

expected.answer: Yes. Annual plans are refunded in full within 14 days of purchase.

input: Where do I download an invoice as a PDF?

expected.answer: Open Billing > Invoices, select the invoice and choose Download.

input: What happens to my workspace when I cancel?

expected.answer: The workspace stays active until the end of the paid period.

input: How do I export all my data?

expected.answer: Owners export all workspace data as CSV from Settings > Data > Export. Exports over 1 GB are split and emailed as links.

input: Can two-factor codes be sent by SMS?

expected.answer: No. Authenticator apps and hardware keys are supported, not SMS.

input: How many people can I invite on the free plan?
Can I charge a late fee on overdue invoices?

expected.answer: Yes. A late fee is a fixed amount or a percentage, applied once when the invoice becomes overdue.

input: I was locked out after failed logins. How long until I can try again?

expected.answer: The account is locked for 15 minutes. An owner can unlock it sooner from Members.

input: When does a downgrade take effect, and are upgrades prorated?

expected.answer: Downgrades take effect at the next renewal. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated.
